searchText: There is a strong economic incentive to wait for the last possible moment because of new txs or new MEV found Are you looking for how it works in vanilla geth or how it works in practice? In practice most blocks have a custom construction due to MEV Yes which is why I think we need to fix the incentive to punish late blocks by ensuring they get excluded from the chain (at least). And we shouldn’t be designing our apis to encourage bad behaviour like proposing late. To be more explicit the real issue is that currently the last possible moment is just before the end of the slot. We need the last possible moment to be at or very slightly after the start of the slot instead. Publishing at the last possible moment isn’t directly the problem, it’s when that last moment is. Wasn't this related to not being able to vote/attest "my slot is empty"
